paragraphs.text: All swimmers must shower before entering the pool. Long hair should be tied back or covered with a swimming cap.
Children under eight must be accompanied in the water by an adult. One adult may accompany a maximum of two children.
Diving is allowed only at the deep end, and only when the lifeguard has removed the barrier. Running on the poolside is not allowed at any time because the floor can be slippery.
Food and drink may not be taken onto the poolside, except for water in plastic bottles. Glass bottles are not allowed anywhere in the building.
Lockers take a £1 coin, which is returned when you open the locker. Please do not leave valuables in the changing rooms.
The pool may close at short notice for swimming competitions, so please always check the website before you visit. Children’s lessons take place on weekday afternoons and Saturday mornings.

items.quote: All swimmers must shower before entering the pool
items.prompt: Swimmers have to 1 ____ before they go into the pool.

explanation.en: “must shower before entering the pool” → shower. After “have to” we need the base form of a verb.
explanation.kk: «must shower before entering the pool» → shower. «Have to» тіркесінен кейін етістіктің бастапқы түрі керек.
explanation.ru: «must shower before entering the pool» → shower. После «have to» нужен глагол в начальной форме.

items.prompt: Swimmers with long hair should tie it back or wear a swimming 2 ____.

explanation.en: “covered with a swimming cap” → cap. “Swimming” is already in the sentence.
explanation.kk: «covered with a swimming cap» → cap. «Swimming» сөйлемде тұр.
explanation.ru: «covered with a swimming cap» → cap. «Swimming» уже стоит в предложении.

items.quote: only when the lifeguard has removed the barrier
items.prompt: Diving is only permitted when the lifeguard has taken away the 3 ____.

explanation.en: Diving is allowed only when the lifeguard “has removed the barrier”. “Taken away” paraphrases “removed”, so the gap is barrier.
explanation.kk: Секіруге құтқарушы «has removed the barrier» болғанда ғана рұқсат. «Taken away» — «removed» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы, бос орынға barrier жазылады.
explanation.ru: Прыгать можно, только когда спасатель «has removed the barrier». «Taken away» пересказывает «removed», в пропуск идёт barrier.

items.quote: because the floor can be slippery
items.prompt: Running is not allowed because the floor may be 4 ____.

explanation.en: “because the floor can be slippery” → slippery. After “may be” we need an adjective.
explanation.kk: «because the floor can be slippery» → slippery. «May be» тіркесінен кейін сын есім керек.
explanation.ru: «because the floor can be slippery» → slippery. После «may be» нужно прилагательное.

items.quote: except for water in plastic bottles
items.prompt: The only drink allowed on the poolside is 5 ____.

explanation.en: “except for water in plastic bottles” → water. “Bottles” are the container, not the drink, and glass bottles are banned.
explanation.kk: «except for water in plastic bottles» → water. «Bottles» — сусын емес, ыдыс; шыны бөтелкеге мүлде тыйым салынған.
explanation.ru: «except for water in plastic bottles» → water. «Bottles» — упаковка, а не напиток; стеклянные бутылки вообще запрещены.
